passages.text: Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to all Israel.
Moses called the heavens to listen.
Moses said, “Heavens, listen to me.”
Moses called the earth to hear him.
Moses said, “Earth, hear the words I speak.”
passages.original: הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וַאֲדַבֵּ֑רָה וְתִשְׁמַ֥ע הָאָ֖רֶץ אִמְרֵי־ פִֽי׃

passages.text: Let my teaching fall like rain and my speech settle like dew, like gentle rain on new grass, like showers on tender plants.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to all Israel.
He recited the words of this song.
He said, "Let my teaching fall like rain.
Let my words settle like dew.
My teaching will be like gentle rain on new grass.
My words will be like showers on tender plants."
passages.original: יַעֲרֹ֤ף כַּמָּטָר֙ לִקְחִ֔י תִּזַּ֥ל כַּטַּ֖ל אִמְרָתִ֑י כִּשְׂעִירִ֣ם עֲלֵי־ דֶ֔שֶׁא וְכִרְבִיבִ֖ים עֲלֵי־ עֵֽשֶׂב׃

passages.text: For I will proclaim the name of the LORD. Ascribe greatness to our God!
passages.sermon:
I will speak the name of the LORD.
The LORD is God.
Give honor to our God.
God is great.
passages.original: כִּ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֶקְרָ֑א הָב֥וּ גֹ֖דֶל לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.
passages.sermon:
God is the Rock.
God is strong and unchanging.
God’s work is perfect.
God does everything without fault.
All God’s ways are just.
God always acts with justice.
God is faithful.
God never does wrong.
God is righteous.
God is upright.
passages.original: הַצּוּר֙ תָּמִ֣ים פָּעֳל֔וֹ כִּ֥י כָל־ דְּרָכָ֖יו מִשְׁפָּ֑ט אֵ֤ל אֱמוּנָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין עָ֔וֶל צַדִּ֥יק וְיָשָׁ֖ר הֽוּא׃

passages.text: His people have acted corruptly toward Him; the spot on them is not that of His children, but of a perverse and crooked generation.
passages.sermon:
God’s people acted corruptly toward Him.
They did not act like His true children.
They showed a stain that did not belong to God’s children.
They belonged to a perverse generation.
They belonged to a crooked generation.
passages.original: שִׁחֵ֥ת ל֛וֹ לֹ֖א בָּנָ֣יו מוּמָ֑ם דּ֥וֹר עִקֵּ֖שׁ וּפְתַלְתֹּֽל׃

passages.text: Is this how you repay the LORD, O foolish and senseless people? Is He not your Father and Creator? Has He not made you and established you?
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your Father and Creator.
He made you.
He established you.
You are His people.
You act foolishly and without understanding.
Is this how you repay the LORD?
passages.original: הֲ־ לַיְהוָה֙ תִּגְמְלוּ־ זֹ֔את עַ֥ם נָבָ֖ל וְלֹ֣א חָכָ֑ם הֲלוֹא־ הוּא֙ אָבִ֣יךָ קָּנֶ֔ךָ ה֥וּא עָֽשְׂךָ֖ וַֽיְכֹנְנֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Remember the days of old; consider the years long past. Ask your father, and he will tell you, your elders, and they will inform you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
He tells them to remember the days of old.
He commands them to think about the years that came before.
He tells them to ask their father about the past.
Their father will tell them what happened.
He tells them to ask their elders.
Their elders will explain it to them.
passages.original: זְכֹר֙ יְמ֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם בִּ֖ינוּ שְׁנ֣וֹת דּוֹר־ וָד֑וֹר שְׁאַ֤ל אָבִ֙יךָ֙ וְיַגֵּ֔דְךָ זְקֵנֶ֖יךָ וְיֹ֥אמְרוּ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when He divided the sons of man, He set the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of God.
passages.sermon:
The Most High is God.
God gave each nation its inheritance.
God divided all the sons of man.
God set the boundaries for every people.
God set these boundaries according to the number of the sons of Israel.
passages.original: בְּהַנְחֵ֤ל עֶלְיוֹן֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם בְּהַפְרִיד֖וֹ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם יַצֵּב֙ גְּבֻלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֔ים לְמִסְפַּ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: But the LORD’s portion is His people, Jacob His allotted inheritance.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD has a special portion.
His portion is His people.
Jacob is His chosen people.
Jacob is the LORD’s allotted inheritance.
passages.original: כִּ֛י חֵ֥לֶק יְהֹוָ֖ה עַמּ֑וֹ יַעֲקֹ֖ב חֶ֥בֶל נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He found him in a desert land, in a barren, howling wilderness; He surrounded him, He instructed him, He guarded him as the apple of His eye.
passages.sermon:
God is the Most High.
God found Jacob in a desert land.
The land was barren.
The land was a howling wilderness.
God surrounded Jacob.
God instructed Jacob.
God guarded Jacob.
God guarded Jacob as the apple of His eye.
passages.original: יִמְצָאֵ֙הוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִדְבָּ֔ר וּבְתֹ֖הוּ יְלֵ֣ל יְשִׁמֹ֑ן יְסֹֽבְבֶ֙נְהוּ֙ יְב֣וֹנְנֵ֔הוּ יִצְּרֶ֖נְהוּ כְּאִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֽוֹ׃

passages.text: As an eagle stirs up its nest and hovers over its young, He spread His wings to catch them and carried them on His pinions.
passages.sermon:
God cares for His people.
God acts with strength and gentleness.
God is like an eagle.
An eagle stirs up its nest.
An eagle hovers over its young.
An eagle spreads its wings.
An eagle catches its young.
An eagle carries its young on its pinions.
God protects and supports His people in the same way.
passages.original: כְּנֶ֙שֶׁר֙ יָעִ֣יר קִנּ֔וֹ עַל־ גּוֹזָלָ֖יו יְרַחֵ֑ף יִפְרֹ֤שׂ כְּנָפָיו֙ יִקָּחֵ֔הוּ יִשָּׂאֵ֖הוּ עַל־ אֶבְרָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The LORD alone led him, and no foreign god was with him.
passages.sermon: The LORD led him.\r\nThe LORD was alone.\r\nNo foreign god was with him.
passages.original: יְהוָ֖ה בָּדָ֣ד יַנְחֶ֑נּוּ וְאֵ֥ין עִמּ֖וֹ אֵ֥ל נֵכָֽר׃

passages.text: He made him ride on the heights of the land and fed him the produce of the field. He nourished him with honey from the rock and oil from the flinty crag, with curds from the herd and milk from the flock, with the fat of lambs, with rams from Bashan, and goats, with the choicest grains of wheat. From the juice of the finest grapes you drank the wine.
passages.sermon:
The LORD cared for Israel.
The LORD made Israel ride on the high places of the land.
The LORD gave Israel food from the fields.
The LORD gave Israel honey from the rock.
The LORD gave Israel oil from the hard stone.
The LORD gave Israel curds from cattle.
The LORD gave Israel milk from sheep.
The LORD gave Israel the fat of lambs.
The LORD gave Israel rams from Bashan.
The LORD gave Israel goats.
The LORD gave Israel the best wheat.
The LORD gave Israel wine from the juice of grapes.
passages.original: יַרְכִּבֵ֙הוּ֙ עַל־ בָּמוֹתֵי אָ֔רֶץ וַיֹּאכַ֖ל תְּנוּבֹ֣ת שָׂדָ֑י וַיֵּנִקֵ֤הֽוּ דְבַשׁ֙ מִסֶּ֔לַע וְשֶׁ֖מֶן מֵחַלְמִ֥ישׁ צֽוּר׃ חֶמְאַ֨ת בָּקָ֜ר וַחֲלֵ֣ב צֹ֗אן עִם־ חֵ֨לֶב כָּרִ֜ים וְאֵילִ֤ים בְּנֵֽי־ בָשָׁן֙ וְעַתּוּדִ֔ים עִם־ חֵ֖לֶב כִּלְי֣וֹת חִטָּ֑ה וְדַם־ עֵנָ֖ב תִּשְׁתֶּה־ חָֽמֶר׃

passages.text: But Jeshurun grew fat and kicked— becoming fat, bloated, and gorged. He abandoned the God who made him and scorned the Rock of his salvation.
passages.sermon:
Jeshurun is a name for Israel.
Jeshurun became prosperous.
Jeshurun grew fat.
Jeshurun became bloated.
Jeshurun became gorged.
Jeshurun rejected God.
God made Jeshurun.
Jeshurun abandoned God.
Jeshurun scorned the Rock.
The Rock is the source of Jeshurun’s salvation.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ן יְשֻׁרוּן֙ וַיִּבְעָ֔ט שָׁמַ֖נְתָּ עָבִ֣יתָ כָּשִׂ֑יתָ וַיִּטֹּשׁ֙ אֱל֣וֹהַ עָשָׂ֔הוּ וַיְנַבֵּ֖ל צ֥וּר יְשֻׁעָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: They provoked His jealousy with foreign gods; they enraged Him with abominations.
passages.sermon:
The people worshiped foreign gods.
They made God jealous.
They did things God hates.
They made God angry.
passages.original: יַקְנִאֻ֖הוּ בְּזָרִ֑ים בְּתוֹעֵבֹ֖ת יַכְעִיסֻֽהוּ׃

passages.text: They sacrificed to demons, not to God, to gods they had not known, to newly arrived gods, which your fathers did not fear.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel offered sacrifices.
They gave these sacrifices to demons.
These demons are not God.
The people did not know these gods before.
These gods appeared only recently.
The ancestors of Israel did not fear these new gods.
passages.original: יִזְבְּח֗וּ לַשֵּׁדִים֙ לֹ֣א אֱלֹ֔הַ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֹ֣א יְדָע֑וּם חֲדָשִׁים֙ מִקָּרֹ֣ב בָּ֔אוּ לֹ֥א שְׂעָר֖וּם אֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You ignored the Rock who brought you forth; you forgot the God who gave you birth.
passages.sermon:
God is the Rock.
God brought you forth.
You ignored God.
God gave you birth.
You forgot God.
passages.original: צ֥וּר יְלָדְךָ֖ תֶּ֑שִׁי וַתִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֵ֥ל מְחֹלְלֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: When the LORD saw this, He rejected them, provoked to anger by His sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD saw what His people did.
His people are His sons and daughters.
The LORD became angry with them.
The LORD rejected them.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥רְא יְהוָ֖ה וַיִּנְאָ֑ץ מִכַּ֥עַס בָּנָ֖יו וּבְנֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: He said: “I will hide My face from them; I will see what will be their end. For they are a perverse generation— children of unfaithfulness.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke.
He said, "I will hide My face from them."
I will watch what happens to them.
They are a perverse generation.
They are children who are not faithful.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אַסְתִּ֤ירָה פָנַי֙ מֵהֶ֔ם אֶרְאֶ֖ה מָ֣ה אַחֲרִיתָ֑ם כִּ֣י ד֤וֹר תַּהְפֻּכֹת֙ הֵ֔מָּה בָּנִ֖ים לֹא־ אֵמֻ֥ן בָּֽם׃

passages.text: They have provoked My jealousy by that which is not God; they have enraged Me with their worthless idols. So I will make them jealous by those who are not a people; I will make them angry by a nation without understanding.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The people of Israel provoked the LORD to jealousy.
They did this with things that are not God.
They made the LORD angry with their worthless idols.
The LORD will make the people of Israel jealous.
He will do this by using those who are not a people.
The LORD will make Israel angry.
He will do this by using a nation that has no understanding.
passages.original: הֵ֚ם קִנְא֣וּנִי בְלֹא־ אֵ֔ל כִּעֲס֖וּנִי בְּהַבְלֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲנִי֙ אַקְנִיאֵ֣ם בְּלֹא־ עָ֔ם בְּג֥וֹי נָבָ֖ל אַכְעִיסֵֽם׃

passages.text: For a fire has been kindled by My anger, and it burns to the depths of Sheol; it consumes the earth and its produce, and scorches the foundations of the mountains.
passages.sermon:
God speaks in this passage.
God is angry.
God’s anger is like a fire.
This fire has started because of God’s anger.
The fire burns down to the depths of Sheol.
The fire consumes the earth.
The fire destroys the earth’s produce.
The fire scorches the foundations of the mountains.
passages.original: כִּי־ אֵשׁ֙ קָדְחָ֣ה בְאַפִּ֔י וַתִּיקַ֖ד עַד־ שְׁא֣וֹל תַּחְתִּ֑ית וַתֹּ֤אכַל אֶ֙רֶץ֙ וִֽיבֻלָ֔הּ וַתְּלַהֵ֖ט מוֹסְדֵ֥י הָרִֽים׃

passages.text: I will heap disasters upon them; I will spend My arrows against them.
passages.sermon: God speaks to His people.\r\nGod says He will bring disasters upon them.\r\nGod says He will use all His arrows against them.
passages.original: אַסְפֶּ֥ה עָלֵ֖ימוֹ רָע֑וֹת חִצַּ֖י אֲכַלֶּה־ בָּֽם׃

passages.text: They will be wasted from hunger and ravaged by pestilence and bitter plague; I will send the fangs of wild beasts against them, with the venom of vipers that slither in the dust.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about His judgment.
God says, “They will suffer from hunger.
Pestilence will strike them.
A bitter plague will harm them.
I will send wild beasts to attack them with their fangs.
I will also send venomous snakes that crawl in the dust against them.”
passages.original: מְזֵ֥י רָעָ֛ב וּלְחֻ֥מֵי רֶ֖שֶׁף וְקֶ֣טֶב מְרִירִ֑י וְשֶׁן־ בְּהֵמוֹת֙ אֲשַׁלַּח־ בָּ֔ם עִם־ חֲמַ֖ת זֹחֲלֵ֥י עָפָֽר׃

passages.text: Outside, the sword will take their children, and inside, terror will strike the young man and the young woman, the infant and the gray-haired man.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Israel.
Israel faces judgment.
Outside, enemies attack with the sword.
The sword kills their children.
Inside, terror fills their homes.
Terror strikes the young man.
Terror strikes the young woman.
Terror strikes the infant.
Terror strikes the old man with gray hair.
passages.original: מִחוּץ֙ תְּשַׁכֶּל־ חֶ֔רֶב וּמֵחֲדָרִ֖ים אֵימָ֑ה גַּם־ בָּחוּר֙ גַּם־ בְּתוּלָ֔ה יוֹנֵ֖ק עִם־ אִ֥ישׁ שֵׂיבָֽה׃

passages.text: I would have said that I would cut them to pieces and blot out their memory from mankind, if I had not dreaded the taunt of the enemy, lest their adversaries misunderstand and say: ‘Our own hand has prevailed; it was not the LORD who did all this.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God spoke about Israel.
God said He would destroy Israel.
God said He would cut Israel to pieces.
God said He would remove Israel’s memory from mankind.
God did not do this.
God feared the enemy’s reaction.
God did not want Israel’s enemies to boast.
God did not want Israel’s enemies to misunderstand.
God did not want Israel’s enemies to say, “We did this by our own power.”
God did not want Israel’s enemies to say, “The LORD did not do all this.”
passages.original: אָמַ֖רְתִּי אַפְאֵיהֶ֑ם אַשְׁבִּ֥יתָה מֵאֱנ֖וֹשׁ זִכְרָֽם׃ לוּלֵ֗י כַּ֤עַס אוֹיֵב֙ אָג֔וּר פֶּֽן־ יְנַכְּר֖וּ צָרֵ֑ימוֹ פֶּן־ יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ יָדֵ֣ינוּ רָ֔מָה וְלֹ֥א יְהוָ֖ה פָּעַ֥ל כָּל־ זֹֽאת׃

passages.text: Israel is a nation devoid of counsel, with no understanding among them.
passages.sermon: Israel is a nation.\r\nIsrael lacks wise advice.\r\nIsrael has no understanding.
passages.original: כִּי־ ג֛וֹי אֹבַ֥ד עֵצ֖וֹת הֵ֑מָּה וְאֵ֥ין בָּהֶ֖ם תְּבוּנָֽה׃

passages.text: If only they were wise, they would understand it; they would comprehend their fate.
passages.sermon:
Israel is a nation.
Israel has no counsel.
Israel has no understanding.
If Israel were wise, they would understand this.
If Israel were wise, they would know their end.
passages.original: ל֥וּ חָכְמ֖וּ יַשְׂכִּ֣ילוּ זֹ֑את יָבִ֖ינוּ לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם׃

passages.text: How could one man pursue a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the LORD had given them up?
passages.sermon:
Israel is a nation without counsel.
Israel has no understanding.
One man cannot chase a thousand by his own power.
Two men cannot make ten thousand flee by themselves.
Their Rock must have sold them for this to happen.
The LORD must have given them up for this to happen.
passages.original: אֵיכָ֞ה יִרְדֹּ֤ף אֶחָד֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁנַ֖יִם יָנִ֣יסוּ רְבָבָ֑ה אִם־ לֹא֙ כִּי־ צוּרָ֣ם מְכָרָ֔ם וַֽיהוָ֖ה הִסְגִּירָֽם׃

passages.text: For their rock is not like our Rock, even our enemies concede.
passages.sermon:
Our Rock is the LORD.
Their rock is not like our Rock.
Even our enemies admit this.
passages.original: כִּ֛י לֹ֥א כְצוּרֵ֖נוּ צוּרָ֑ם וְאֹיְבֵ֖ינוּ פְּלִילִֽים׃

passages.text: But their vine is from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poisonous; their clusters are bitter.
passages.sermon:
Their vine comes from Sodom.
Their fields come from Gomorrah.
Their grapes are poisonous.
Their clusters are bitter.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ מִגֶּ֤פֶן סְדֹם֙ גַּפְנָ֔ם וּמִשַּׁדְמֹ֖ת עֲמֹרָ֑ה עֲנָבֵ֙מוֹ֙ עִנְּבֵי־ ר֔וֹשׁ אַשְׁכְּלֹ֥ת מְרֹרֹ֖ת לָֽמוֹ׃

passages.text: Their wine is the venom of serpents, the deadly poison of cobras.
passages.sermon:
The people in this passage are enemies of God.
Their wine is not ordinary.
Their wine is like the venom of serpents.
Their wine is like the deadly poison of cobras.
passages.original: חֲמַ֥ת תַּנִּינִ֖ם יֵינָ֑ם וְרֹ֥אשׁ פְּתָנִ֖ים אַכְזָֽר׃

passages.text: “Have I not stored up these things, sealed up within My vaults?
passages.sermon:
God speaks in this passage.
God says He has stored up these things.
God has sealed these things within His vaults.
passages.original: הֲלֹא־ ה֖וּא כָּמֻ֣ס עִמָּדִ֑י חָתֻ֖ם בְּאוֹצְרֹתָֽי׃

passages.text: Vengeance is Mine; I will repay. In due time their foot will slip; for their day of disaster is near, and their doom is coming quickly.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks these words.
God says, “Vengeance belongs to Me.
I will repay.
At the right time, their foot will slip.
Their day of disaster is near.
Their doom is coming quickly.”
passages.original: לִ֤י נָקָם֙ וְשִׁלֵּ֔ם לְעֵ֖ת תָּמ֣וּט רַגְלָ֑ם כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם אֵידָ֔ם וְחָ֖שׁ עֲתִדֹ֥ת לָֽמוֹ׃

passages.text: For the LORD will vindicate His people and have compassion on His servants when He sees that their strength is gone and no one remains, slave or free.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD judges His people.
The LORD shows compassion to His servants.
The LORD sees when His people have no strength left.
The LORD sees when no one remains to help them.
The LORD sees when there is no one left, slave or free.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יָדִ֤ין יְהוָה֙ עַמּ֔וֹ וְעַל־ עֲבָדָ֖יו יִתְנֶחָ֑ם כִּ֤י יִרְאֶה֙ כִּי־ אָ֣זְלַת יָ֔ד וְאֶ֖פֶס עָצ֥וּר וְעָזֽוּב׃

passages.text: He will say: “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge, which ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up and help you; let them give you shelter!
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people who turned away from Him.
He asks them a question.
He says, “Where are your gods now?”
He calls these gods the rock in which you took refuge.
These false gods received the fat of your sacrifices.
They drank the wine of your drink offerings.
God commands these gods to rise up and help you.
He tells them to give you shelter.
passages.original: וְאָמַ֖ר אֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑ימוֹ צ֖וּר חָסָ֥יוּ בֽוֹ׃ אֲשֶׁ֨ר חֵ֤לֶב זְבָחֵ֙ימוֹ֙ יֹאכֵ֔לוּ יִשְׁתּ֖וּ יֵ֣ין נְסִיכָ֑ם יָק֙וּמוּ֙ וְיַעְזְרֻכֶ֔ם יְהִ֥י עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם סִתְרָֽה׃

passages.text: See now that I am He; there is no God besides Me. I bring death and I give life; I wound and I heal, and there is no one who can deliver from My hand.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God is the LORD.
God says, “Look now and see.
I am He.
I alone am God.
There is no other god with Me.
I cause death.
I give life.
I strike down.
I heal.
No one can rescue from My hand.”
passages.original: רְא֣וּ׀ עַתָּ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י אֲנִי֙ ה֔וּא וְאֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּדִ֑י אֲנִ֧י אָמִ֣ית וַאֲחַיֶּ֗ה מָחַ֙צְתִּי֙ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶרְפָּ֔א וְאֵ֥ין מִיָּדִ֖י מַצִּֽיל׃

passages.text: For I lift up My hand to heaven and declare: As surely as I live forever, when I sharpen My flashing sword, and My hand grasps it in judgment, I will take vengeance on My adversaries and repay those who hate Me.
passages.sermon:
God speaks these words.
God is eternal.
God lives forever.
God lifts His hand to heaven.
God makes a solemn declaration.
God says, “I live forever.”
God sharpens His flashing sword.
God’s hand takes hold of judgment.
God will take vengeance on His adversaries.
God will repay those who hate Him.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶל־ שָׁמַ֖יִם יָדִ֑י וְאָמַ֕רְתִּי חַ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י לְעֹלָֽם׃ אִם־ שַׁנּוֹתִי֙ בְּרַ֣ק חַרְבִּ֔י וְתֹאחֵ֥ז בְּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט יָדִ֑י אָשִׁ֤יב נָקָם֙ לְצָרָ֔י וְלִמְשַׂנְאַ֖י אֲשַׁלֵּֽם׃

passages.text: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, while My sword devours flesh— the blood of the slain and captives, the heads of the enemy leaders.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks these words.
God is the only true God.
God says, “I will make My arrows drunk with blood.
My sword will eat flesh.
My arrows will be covered with the blood of the dead.
My arrows will be covered with the blood of captives.
My sword will strike the heads of enemy leaders.”
passages.original: אַשְׁכִּ֤יר חִצַּי֙ מִדָּ֔ם וְחַרְבִּ֖י תֹּאכַ֣ל בָּשָׂ֑ר מִדַּ֤ם חָלָל֙ וְשִׁבְיָ֔ה מֵרֹ֖אשׁ פַּרְע֥וֹת אוֹיֵֽב׃

passages.text: Rejoice, O heavens, with Him, and let all God’s angels worship Him. Rejoice, O nations, with His people; for He will avenge the blood of His children. He will take vengeance on His adversaries and repay those who hate Him; He will cleanse His land and His people.
passages.sermon:
God is the Lord of all nations and all creation.
God commands the heavens to rejoice with Him.
God commands all God's angels to worship Him.
God commands all nations to rejoice with His people.
God will avenge the blood of His servants.
God will take vengeance on His adversaries.
God will repay those who hate Him.
God will cleanse His land.
God will cleanse His people.
passages.original: הַרְנִ֤ינוּ גוֹיִם֙ עַמּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י דַם־ עֲבָדָ֖יו יִקּ֑וֹם וְנָקָם֙ יָשִׁ֣יב לְצָרָ֔יו וְכִפֶּ֥ר אַדְמָת֖וֹ עַמּֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: Then Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and recited all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Joshua was the son of Nun.
Moses came to the people.
Joshua son of Nun came with him.
Moses spoke all the words of this song.
He spoke these words so all the people could hear.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַשִּׁירָֽה־ הַזֹּ֖את בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם ה֖וּא וְהוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בִּן־ נֽוּן׃

passages.text: When Moses had finished reciting all these words to all Israel, he said to them, “Take to heart all these words I testify among you today, so that you may command your children to carefully follow all the words of this law.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
He finished speaking all these words to all Israel.
He spoke to the people.
He said, “Take to heart all these words I testify among you today.
Teach your children to keep and do all the words of this law.”
passages.original: וַיְכַ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה לְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֶל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ שִׂ֣ימוּ לְבַבְכֶ֔ם לְכָל־ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מֵעִ֥יד בָּכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר תְּצַוֻּם֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵיכֶ֔ם לִשְׁמֹ֣ר לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֖י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

passages.text: For they are not idle words to you, because they are your life, and by them you will live long in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to all Israel.
He spoke about the words of the law.
These words are not empty for you.
These words are your life.
If you keep these words, you will live long.
You will live long in the land.
You are crossing the Jordan to take this land.
God is giving you this land to possess.
passages.original: כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ דָבָ֨ר רֵ֥ק הוּא֙ מִכֶּ֔ם כִּי־ ה֖וּא חַיֵּיכֶ֑ם וּבַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה תַּאֲרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ עַל־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃פ

passages.text: On that same day the LORD said to Moses, “Go up into the Abarim Range to Mount Nebo, in the land of Moab across from Jericho, and view the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites as their own possession.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses on that very day.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to go up into the Abarim Range.
The LORD told Moses to go to Mount Nebo.
Mount Nebo is in the land of Moab.
Mount Nebo is across from Jericho.
The LORD told Moses to look at the land of Canaan.
The LORD said He is giving the land of Canaan to the Israelites.
The LORD said the Israelites will possess the land of Canaan.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּעֶ֛צֶם הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ עֲלֵ֡ה אֶל־ הַר֩ הָעֲבָרִ֨ים הַזֶּ֜ה הַר־ נְב֗וֹ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹ וּרְאֵה֙ אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֥י נֹתֵ֛ן לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַאֲחֻזָּֽה׃

passages.text: And there on the mountain that you climb, you will die and be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God told Moses to climb a mountain.
The mountain was called Mount Nebo.
It was in the land of Moab.
God said Moses would die on that mountain.
God said Moses would be gathered to his people after he died.
God reminded Moses about Aaron.
Aaron was Moses’ brother.
Aaron died on Mount Hor.
Aaron was gathered to his people after he died.
God said the same would happen to Moses.
passages.original: וּמֻ֗ת בָּהָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ עֹלֶ֣ה שָׁ֔מָּה וְהֵאָסֵ֖ף אֶל־ עַמֶּ֑יךָ כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־ מֵ֞ת אַהֲרֹ֤ן אָחִ֙יךָ֙ בְּהֹ֣ר הָהָ֔ר וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־ עַמָּֽיו׃

passages.text: For at the waters of Meribah-kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin, both of you broke faith with Me among the Israelites by failing to treat Me as holy in their presence.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God referred to an event among the Israelites.
This event happened at the waters of Meribah-kadesh.
Meribah-kadesh is in the Wilderness of Zin.
Moses and Aaron broke faith with God there.
They did this among the Israelites.
They failed to treat God as holy in the presence of the Israelites.
passages.original: עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר מְעַלְתֶּ֜ם בִּ֗י בְּתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּמֵֽי־ מְרִיבַ֥ת קָדֵ֖שׁ מִדְבַּר־ צִ֑ן עַ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ קִדַּשְׁתֶּם֙ אוֹתִ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Although you shall see from a distance the land that I am giving the Israelites, you shall not enter it.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God said, “You will see the land from a distance.
I am giving this land to the Israelites.
You will not enter this land.”
passages.original: כִּ֥י מִנֶּ֖גֶד תִּרְאֶ֣ה אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשָׁ֙מָּה֙ לֹ֣א תָב֔וֹא אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֥י נֹתֵ֖ן לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
